snippet.title: SHROUDED SUNS - GAMEPLAY TEASER
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4060820/Shrouded_Suns

In the midst of a seemingly hopeless war among the stars, take control of highly customizable spacefighters to experience classic space combat action throughout a story-driven campaign.

SHROUDED SUNS takes the immersion, atmosphere, and tension at the heart of retro classics of the space game genre and combines it with intuitive controls to give you an experience that is easy to pick up without letting physics get in the way of the action.

#spacecombat #indiegame #spacegames #godot #ShroudedSuns
